corrections.old: mentioned
corrections.new: stated
corrections.reason: PROTOCOL section 3 says an explicit zero is a stated value, not an absence: 'no fee' must be recorded as stated when the applicable evidence states it. The cell's only claim, claim_chennai_ptax_online_nil_transaction_fee (Grade B, verified, observation), records the corporation's own statement of a 'Nil' transaction fee for paying online by credit card, debit card or net banking. That is an amount a citizen pays for this service's online channel, which is the section 8 cost test for stated, and it is none of the three mentioned triggers: it is not a fee described only as prescribed, not a payment step without an amount, and not a penalty payable by the agency. The cell note misreads section 3 as a rule that keeps the cell from being scored absent; section 3 makes the explicit zero stated. The separate fact that the tax liability itself cannot be derived is carried by claim_chennai_ptax_amount_payable_unknown, an Unknown claim, which under section 8 records a limitation and cannot set a cell value in either direction. On application, the cell note must be rewritten as an actionable-value note per section 9; that rewrite is recorded as a finding, not encoded here.

support.auditNote: F1. Supporting claim claim_chennai_ptax_online_nil_transaction_fee is verified and Grade B, so it satisfies the section 8 rule that only verified or partial claims may support stated. Grade B is within the A/B/C range section 8 requires for stated.

corrections.reason: PROTOCOL section 5 reserves mixed for a claim whose notes explain the boundary between what a source directly shows and what is concluded from it. After the IND-91 part B split this claim asserts only that the corporation publishes a Property Tax Online Payment Receipt route reachable without login, and its own notes state that the route, its title and its four input fields were observed on the access date. The inferential part, what the route returns for a real property, moved to claim_chennai_ptax_public_receipt_route_2, whose notes carry the boundary. No inference remains inside this claim, so mixed is a residue of the split and observation is the correct basis. Status is deliberately left at partial: section 13 lists downgrading rather than upgrading among the auditor's powers, and section 8 permits a partial claim to support the stated after-submission cell.
